const long long MOD = 998244353LL;

    long long res = 1LL;
    x = x % p;
    while (y > 0) {
        if (y & 1)
            res = (res * x) % p;
        y = y >> 1;
        x = (x * x) % p;
    }
    return res;
}

        cout << res << endl;
    }

}
